UAT-found defect A (2026-07-21, cross-run folder fork): 'first folder assignment wins' (vision 03 §3.2) was only applied within one run's in-memory aggregation, and sorted extraction-file order let a run-2 folder win, forking jane-doe into entities/people/executives while the run-1 page at entities/people/board-members went stale and rolling memory was overwritten. Fix: the canonical folder for any slug already in the PREVIOUS rolling memory comes from that memory (extraction folder fields are ignored for placement; the divergent folder is never added to folderStructure on that entity's account); fork orphans under entities/ are reconciled — unmodified tool writes (on-disk hash matches .state/ingestion.json pageHashes) are DELETED with 'Removed duplicate page <path> (entity now lives at <canonical path>).', edited/untracked orphans are KEPT and logged to .state/conflicts.json (manual-edit shape, additive optional reason override in logManualEditConflict). Rolling memory never moves an existing entity.

UAT-found defect A, repair semantics: ingest now also materializes when EVERY PDF is hash-skipped (guarded on existing .state/extracted JSON so extraction-less wikis keep their rolling memory untouched), so one more ingest of any kind repairs an already-forked wiki. Re-derivation from the same extraction set is idempotent and recorded hashes prevent false manual-edit conflicts; full suite confirms no behavior drift.

UAT-found defect B (2026-07-21, crash-safe finalization): three live TUI ingests finished all LLM stages but were interrupted before metrics.json/language.json were written (the window is large because even all-skipped runs re-run the DOX suite). Fix: a preliminary write of language state + metrics.json (same computation, totalCost excluding the not-yet-run DOX/workspace calls) lands immediately after the post-synthesis re-hash block, BEFORE validation/DOX; the final writes still refresh both (metrics with the final totalCost). Both metrics writes are try/catch-hardened: failure logs 'Warning: could not record (preliminary )ingestion metrics: <msg>' via progress and never fails the run. Which stages run is UNCHANGED (the zero-change-run efficiency question stays a pending user decision).

Defect B regression-test note: a throwing writeDoxIndexFn/writeWorkspaceIndexFn/writeWorkspaceProseFn stub does NOT propagate — the Phase 6/7 contract retries then falls back to the deterministic contract, so 'error propagates as before' means the run completes exactly as before; the test proves the preliminary write by observing metrics.json/language.json mid-run inside the throwing stub. ingest gains an additive test-only writeWorkspaceProseFn pass-through (the 2026-07-21b prose amendment's call is otherwise unstubbable at ingest level — first ingest-level doxLlm:true test).
